prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 21 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1295; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed head-on motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck and low back pain, muscle tightness, and reduced range of motion. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the force of the collision and with the symptoms described. Cervical and lumbar paraspinal tenderness and restricted active motion were documented on examination, while neurological screening, reflexes, and motor strength remained within normal limits. The patient has no known prior injury or treatment involving the cervical or lumbar spine. Care was delivered over 21 visits, which is somewhat longer than typical for uncomplicated cervical and lumbar strain, and included manual therapy, therapeutic exercise, and home exercise instruction. Progress has been gradual, with improvement in pain scores and mobility over the course of treatment. Billed services reviewed for this episode show no duplicated or repeated charges. Ongoing care will focus on strengthening and a graded return to usual activities, with reassessment planned at discharge.
